slices.title: Re-implement AI dialogue logic on main
slices.jtbd: When implementing the unmerged AI logic for this epic, I want to write the changes directly against the latest main branch, so that the feature is integrated without the design clashes that blocked the previous branch.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the current state of the main branch,
When the AI dialogue logic is re-implemented,
Then it must integrate seamlessly without architectural conflicts.
Given the 2 follow-up concerns from the abandoned PR,
When the new code is reviewed,
Then it must demonstrably address both concerns.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce AI logic merge conflict rate to 0%
